title: Bootstrap founder, INR 50,000 and 30 days
scenario:
TOPIC: Bootstrap an AI automation business with ₹50,000 in 30 days
I am a solo founder in India with basic coding skills, ₹50,000 total cash, and 30 days to win my first paying customer. I want an AI automation business but have not chosen an industry. Propose one narrow niche and one concrete offer, define the smallest sellable MVP, give a customer-acquisition plan and pricing, identify the main risks, and finish with a detailed first seven-day plan. Make a clear decision rather than listing unrelated ideas.

bad_signs.name: generic perseverance advice
bad_signs.pattern: work hard|stay focused|be consistent|success depends on execution

improvement_suggestions: Choose one buyer and state exactly what that buyer receives.
Turn the opening week into scheduled actions with accountable parties.
Ground the recommendation in the founder's cash and skill constraints.
